name: Toushima Katsuhiko
source:
An ordinary employee at a struggling family restaurant chain, but somehow is suddenly promoted to manager.

Lured by the bait that he could be listed as an executive candidate depending on performance... he agrees to take on the owner's unreasonable demands.

A latent boob lover, his fetish gradually awakens as he trains Kotomi and Reina.
